_description: Shopify platform constraints, plan tiers, Liquid capabilities, and OS 2.0 features

starter.notes: No full online store — link-in-bio and social commerce only

plus.notes: Required for checkout customization, Shopify Functions, and advanced automation

dynamic-pricing.solution: Shopify Scripts (Plus only) or pricing app

custom-forms.solution: Metaobjects + Liquid or form builder app

user-accounts-custom.solution: Customer accounts with metafields, or gating app

multi-language.solution: Shopify Markets with auto-translation or manual translation

advanced-search.solution: Shopify Search & Discovery app (free) or third-party

ab-testing.solution: Third-party tools or Shopify Plus LaunchPad

custom-checkout.solution: Checkout Extensibility (Plus only) or checkout apps
custom-checkout.notes: Standard plans cannot modify checkout beyond basic settings

sectionsEverywhere.description: Sections can be added to any template, not just homepage

appBlocks.description: Third-party apps render as blocks within sections (no code injection)
appBlocks.legacy: Apps inject code via ScriptTag API, modifying theme files

metaobjects.description: Custom content types with structured data, accessible in Liquid

jsonTemplates.description: Templates defined as JSON instead of Liquid, enabling visual customization

sectionGroups.description: Group sections across templates (e.g., shared header/footer)

predictiveSearch.description: Built-in autocomplete search with product, collection, article, page results

legacyLimitations: No app blocks — apps inject code into theme files directly
No JSON templates — all templates are Liquid files
No section groups — header/footer defined in theme.liquid
Harder to update themes without losing customizations

performanceConsiderations.imageOptimization: Shopify CDN auto-serves WebP/AVIF, provides srcset via image_url filter
performanceConsiderations.lazyLoading: Native lazy loading in modern themes (loading='lazy')
performanceConsiderations.criticalCSS: Themes should inline critical CSS; Dawn does this natively
performanceConsiderations.jsBundle: Theme JS is typically < 50KB; app JS is the main bloat source
performanceConsiderations.thirdPartyApps: Each app can add 50-200KB+ JS; more than 5-6 apps degrades performance significantly
performanceConsiderations.liquidRenderTime: Liquid rendering timeout at 10 seconds; complex templates can hit this
performanceConsiderations.cdnCaching: Shopify CDN caches assets globally; cache-busting via URL params

shopifyFunctions.description: Shopify Functions replace Scripts — serverless functions that run at checkout for custom logic

discounts.description: Custom discount logic — volume discounts, tiered pricing, bundle discounts, conditional discounts
discounts.replaces: Shopify Scripts (Plus only) for discount logic
discounts.notes: Written in Rust/WASM. Deploy via Shopify CLI. Max execution time: 5ms.

shipping.description: Custom shipping rates — hide/rename/reorder shipping methods, custom rate calculation
shipping.notes: Can filter, rename, and reorder carrier-calculated rates. Cannot create rates from scratch (use Carrier Service API for that).

payment.description: Custom payment method filtering — hide/reorder/rename payment methods based on cart contents, customer tags, etc.
payment.notes: Cannot add new payment methods. Can hide or sort existing ones.

cartTransform.description: Modify cart line items at checkout — merge lines, expand bundles, apply automatic changes
cartTransform.notes: Useful for bundle pricing, free gifts, and automatic add-ons.

fulfillmentConstraints.notes: Plus-only. Route orders to specific locations based on custom rules.

validation.description: Cart and checkout validation — block checkout based on custom rules (min order, restricted items, etc.)
validation.notes: Can prevent checkout submission with custom error messages.

limitations: Written in Rust (compiled to WASM) — not JavaScript
No network calls from within functions
Limited input data (cart, customer, shop context only)
Deployed via Shopify CLI as part of an app
shopifyFunctions.migration: Shopify Scripts (Plus) are deprecated in favor of Functions. New stores should use Functions. Existing Scripts will be supported until 2025 sunset date (extended).

features: Shopify Magic (AI) — product descriptions, email subject lines, image editing
Sidekick (AI assistant) — natural language store management
Checkout Extensibility GA — customize checkout on all Plus stores
Combined Listings — group products under a single listing (like color variants that are separate products)
Shopify Subscriptions app improvements — dunning management, prepaid subscriptions
Markets Pro — simplified international selling with duties/taxes handled by Shopify
Hydrogen improvements — Remix-based Shopify storefront framework
Oxygen hosting — Shopify's hosting for Hydrogen storefronts
Metaobject improvements — bulk editing, more field types, better Liquid access
Semantic search — AI-powered search understanding intent, not just keywords
Tokengating sunset — replaced by blockchain-agnostic gating apps
Audiences expansion — available on more plans
